name: has_high_qs_ranking_education
description: Founder has education with QS rank less than or equal to 50
expression: lambda founder: any(parse_qs(e.get('qs_ranking', '')) <= 50 for e in founder.get('educations', []))

name: industry_is_tech_or_software
description: Founder industry is related to Technology or Software
expression: lambda founder: 'software' in founder.get('industry', '').lower() or 'technology' in founder.get('industry', '').lower() or 'information' in founder.get('industry', '').lower()

name: has_exited_firm
description: Founder has IPO or acquisition event

name: has_experience_in_industry
description: Founder has at least one job in the same industry
expression: lambda founder: any(parse_company_size(job.get('company_size', '')) > 0 for job in founder.get('jobs', []))

name: long_professional_experience
description: Founder has more than 9 years of professional experience
expression: lambda founder: any(parse_duration(job.get('duration', '')) >= 9 for job in founder.get('jobs', []))

name: has_graduate_degree
description: Founder holds a postgraduate degree (e.g., MBA, MS, PhD)
expression: lambda founder: any(e.get('degree', '').lower() in ['mba', 'ms', 'phd', 'fellowship'] for e in founder.get('educations', []))

name: industry_in_management_or_professional_services
description: Founder industry is Management or Professional Services
expression: lambda founder: 'management' in founder.get('industry', '').lower() or 'professional' in founder.get('industry', '').lower() or 'strategy' in founder.get('industry', '').lower()

name: has_education_in_top_qs
description: Founder has education in top QS ranked institution (rank 1-50)
expression: lambda founder: any(parse_qs(e.get('qs_ranking', '')) <= 50 for e in founder.get('educations', []))

name: industry_is_in_healthcare
description: Founder industry relates to healthcare or medical
expression: lambda founder: 'health' in founder.get('industry', '').lower() or 'medical' in founder.get('industry', '').lower() or 'clinical' in founder.get('industry', '').lower()

name: has_startup_experience
description: Founder has held a CEO, founder, or co-founder role
expression: lambda founder: any(job.get('role', '').lower() in ['co-founder', 'founder', 'ceo', 'president'] for job in founder.get('jobs', []))

name: industry_is_in_digital_or_internet
description: Founder industry is related to Digital or Internet platforms
expression: lambda founder: 'digital' in founder.get('industry', '').lower() or 'internet' in founder.get('industry', '').lower() or 'platform' in founder.get('industry', '').lower()

name: has_education_in_science_or_engineering
description: Founder has a degree in science, engineering, or related fields
expression: lambda founder: any(e.get('field', '').lower() in ['engineering', 'science', 'biotechnology', 'bioinformatics', 'materials science', 'computer science', 'informatics'] for e in founder.get('educations', []))

name: industry_is_in_finance_or_investment
description: Founder industry is finance or investment
expression: lambda founder: 'finance' in founder.get('industry', '').lower() or 'investment' in founder.get('industry', '').lower() or 'private equity' in founder.get('industry', '').lower() or 'venture capital' in founder.get('industry', '').lower()

name: has_experience_in_management_roles
description: Founder has held management or executive roles
expression: lambda founder: any('manager' in job.get('role', '').lower() or 'director' in job.get('role', '').lower() or 'vp' in job.get('role', '').lower() or 'president' in job.get('role', '').lower() for job in founder.get('jobs', []))

name: has_experience_in_technology_roles
description: Founder has held roles related to technology or engineering
expression: lambda founder: any('engineer' in job.get('role', '').lower() or 'developer' in job.get('role', '').lower() or 'scientist' in job.get('role', '').lower() for job in founder.get('jobs', []))

name: industry_has_exited_companies
description: Founder has been involved in companies that exited via IPO or acquisition

name: has_degree_in_business_or_management
description: Founder holds a business or management degree
expression: lambda founder: any(e.get('field', '').lower() in ['business', 'management', 'leadership', 'organizational management', 'entrepreneurship'] for e in founder.get('educations', []))
